assumptions: ExecutionReads carries a required internal leafSteps map; public startable/person/claim DTOs keep their shapes. No package union or property-presence inference supplies current order.
Current Source tree metadata supplies local execution; SQLite captures it synchronously on the admitted existing transaction, and connected members retain their required captured own inventories.

Actual scoped claim tests use Source.uow, borrowed service composition and the real limits gauge. They retain existing claim identity/lease/occupancy/quota/auth rules instead of making the public ordinary stores an uncapped writer.
By-person access and ordinary read composition retain their existing guarantees; these cases do not add or certify a new snapshot isolation promise.
Missing consumer metadata is injected into a detached actual execution response to exercise production consumers; this is not proof of every Source observation/lifetime path.

implementation.execution: ExecutionReads replaces global stepIds with required leafSteps. SQLite resolves per-leaf metadata in the caller transaction, uses leaf order for every local/member graph, and returns the target own map. Local statusReadsOf captures required current tree metadata; ordinary journal/context rows remain ordinary.
implementation.consumers: Startable work enumerates each leaf own order. Claim admission and ClaimTarget enumerate only its own steps; unresolved known package steps return step_not_resolved, absent package policies retain unknown_step, empty leaves return no_steps. New-start claim replay uses the current tree purpose. By-person step ordering is per addressed leaf, with nullable subtree ordering retained.
implementation.readiness: Required own capture validates the complete census. Progress, blockages and attempts must name own resolved leaf pairs, not merely a row and policy somewhere in the package.
